ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with a macro-level ratio of approximately 1:7 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels within the fluke boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black base field across both lobes. Distinct high-intensity white blobs concentrated at the distal edge of the right lobe. Dense network of white linear streaks distributed across the central portions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire boundary; right lobe exhibits larger, irregular peaks (10-15 pixels) while the left lobe displays a more uniform, lower-amplitude sawtooth pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curves on both lobes; the right lobe distal sweep is more pronounced and shorter compared to the more elongated convex curve of the left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Significant cluster of white circular pixel groups localized on the outer distal edge of the right lobe; smaller isolated circular marks along the trailing edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous white linear pixel disruptions across both lobes; parallel sets of diagonal tracks are highly visible against the black base pigmentation on the central and inner lobe surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregularity and thickening of the right lobe tip profile due to a dense concentration of high-intensity white markings and structural protrusions.
